text:
Denver Barkey is a 2023 third-round pick who won Memorial Cup games with the London Knights, and Broad Street Hockey has already called him an analytical darling. You can see why. Philadelphia gets 55.6 percent of the expected goals (chance quality) at 5v5 with him on the ice, 16.9 points better than without him, on a team that has struggled to control play.

His scoring line is modest: one goal, seven points in 15 games, four of them on the power play, where the Inquirer singled out his work as a bright spot. He shoots rarely and passes first, a profile our comparisons match to Pierre-Luc Dubois and Kaapo Kakko. Evolving-Hockey had him in the 91st percentile at taking chances away last season.

Nothing about his numbers looks inflated. If anything his on-ice shooting has run slightly cold. Our range puts him around 37 points, and his ice time is creeping up. Barkey is the kind of player who earns a coach's trust one shift at a time.
headline: Barkey does the little things the numbers notice
